title: एकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Arjuna performs fierce austerities on the Himalaya, living on leaves and then air, standing with arms raised. The alarmed sages go to Shiva, who reassures them that he knows Arjuna's purpose and will fulfil it.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಹಿಮಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆ, ಅನಂತರ ಗಾಳಿಯನ್ನೇ ಆಹಾರವಾಗಿಸಿ ತೋಳೆತ್ತಿ ನಿಂತು ಉಗ್ರ ತಪಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆತಂಕಗೊಂಡ ಋಷಿಗಳು ಶಿವನಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋದಾಗ, ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ತನಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ನೆರವೇರಿಸುವೆ ಎಂದು ಶಿವನು ಸಮಾಧಾನಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन हिमालय पर पत्तों और फिर वायु पर रहकर भुजाएँ उठाए कठोर तप करते हैं। चिन्तित ऋषि शिव के पास जाते हैं, जो आश्वासन देते हैं कि वे अर्जुन का उद्देश्य जानते हैं और उसे पूरा करेंगे।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు హిమాలయాల్లో ఆకులు, తర్వాత గాలినే ఆహారంగా చేసుకొని చేతులెత్తి నిలిచి ఉగ్ర తపస్సు చేస్తాడు. కలవరపడిన ఋషులు శివుని వద్దకు వెళ్లగా, అర్జునుని ఉద్దేశం తనకు తెలుసని, దానిని నెరవేరుస్తానని శివుడు భరోసా ఇస్తాడు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் இமயத்தில் இலைகள், பின்னர் காற்றை மட்டுமே உண்டு கைகளை உயர்த்தி நின்று கடுந்தவம் செய்கிறான். கலக்கமுற்ற முனிவர்கள் ஶிவனிடம் செல்ல, அர்ஜுனனின் நோக்கம் தமக்குத் தெரியும், அதை நிறைவேற்றுவேன் என்று ஶிவன் உறுதியளிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ഹിമാലയത്തിൽ അർജുനൻ ഘോരതപസ്സ് ചെയ്യുന്നു; ആദ്യം ഇലകൾ മാത്രം, പിന്നെ വായു മാത്രം ഭക്ഷിച്ച്, കൈകളുയർത്തി നിൽക്കുന്നു. പരിഭ്രാന്തരായ ഋഷിമാർ ശിവന്റെ അടുത്തെത്തുന്നു; അർജുനന്റെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യം അറിയാമെന്നും അത് സഫലമാക്കുമെന്നും ശിവൻ അവരെ ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.39; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
भगवञ्श्रोतुमिच्छामि पार्थस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।
विस्तरेण कथामेतां यथास्त्राण्युपलब्धवान् ॥

meaning.en: "Blessed one, I wish to hear in full this story of Partha, whose deeds are effortless: how he obtained the weapons."

verses.text:
कथं स पुरुषव्याघ्रो दीर्घबाहुर्धनंजयः ।
वनं प्रविष्टस्तेजस्वी निर्मनुष्यमभीतवत् ॥

meaning.en: "How did that tiger among men, long-armed, radiant Dhananjaya, enter the forest empty of men, without fear?"

verses.text:
किं च तेन कृतं तत्र वसता ब्रह्मवित्तम ।
कथं च भगवान्स्थाणुर्देवराजश्च तोषितः ॥

meaning.en: "And what did he do while living there, best of knowers of Brahman? How were the blessed Sthanu and the king of the gods pleased?"

verses.text:
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं त्वत्प्रसादाद्द्विजोत्तम ।
त्वं हि सर्वज्ञ दिव्यं च मानुषं चैव वेत्थ ह ॥

meaning.en: "By your grace, best of brahmins, I wish to hear this, for you, all-knowing, know both the divine and the human."

verses.text:
अत्यद्भुतं महाप्राज्ञ रोमहर्षणमर्जुनः ।
भवेन सह संग्रामं चकाराप्रतिमं किल ।
पुरा प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः संग्रामेष्वपराजितः ॥

meaning.en: "Wise one, it is most wondrous and makes the hair stand on end: they say Arjuna, best of fighters and unbeaten in battle, fought a matchless fight with Bhava."

verses.text:
यच्छ्रुत्वा नरसिंहानां दैन्यहर्षातिविस्मयात् ।
शूराणामपि पार्थानां हृदयानि चकम्पिरे ॥

meaning.en: "Hearing of it, even the hearts of the brave Parthas, lions among men, trembled with dejection, joy and wonder."

verses.text:
यद्यच्च कृतवानन्यत्पार्थस्तदखिलं वद ।
न ह्यस्य निन्दितं जिष्णोः सुसूक्ष्ममपि लक्षये ।
चरितं तस्य शूरस्य तन्मे सर्वं प्रकीर्तय ॥

meaning.en: "Tell me all else that Partha did. I do not see even the slightest fault in Jishnu; tell me all about the deeds of that hero."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
कथयिष्यामि ते तात कथामेतां महात्मनः ।
दिव्यां कौरवशार्दूल महतीमद्भुतोपमाम् ॥

meaning.en: "I will tell you, dear, this story of the great-souled one, divine, great and wondrous, O tiger of the Kurus."

verses.text:
गात्रसंस्पर्शसंबन्धं त्र्यम्बकेण सहानघ ।
पार्थस्य देवदेवेन शृणु सम्यक्समागमम् ॥

meaning.en: "Hear fully, blameless one, how Partha came into bodily contact with Tryambaka, the god of gods, and met him."

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरनियोगात्स जगामामितविक्रमः ।
शक्रं सुरेश्वरं द्रष्टुं देवदेवं च शंकरम् ॥

meaning.en: "At Yudhishthira's command the man of immeasurable valor went to see Shakra, lord of the gods, and Shankara, the god of gods."

verses.text:
दिव्यं तद्धनुरादाय खड्गं च पुरुषर्षभः ।
महाबलो महाबाहुरर्जुनः कार्यसिद्धये ।
दिशं ह्युदीचीं कौरव्यो हिमवच्छिखरं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: "Taking that divine bow and a sword, the bull among men, mighty and long-armed Arjuna, the Kuru, went for the success of his purpose toward the northern direction and the peak of the Himalaya."

verses.text:
ऐन्द्रिः स्थिरमना राजन्सर्वलोकमहारथः ।
त्वरया परया युक्तस्तपसे धृतनिश्चयः ।
वनं कण्टकितं घोरमेक एवान्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: "Indra's son, steady in mind, a great charioteer of all the worlds, with great speed and firm resolve for austerity, went alone into a dreadful, thorny forest."

verses.text:
नानापुष्पफलोपेतं नानापक्षिनिषेवितम् ।
नानामृगगणाकीर्णं सिद्धचारणसेवितम् ॥

meaning.en: "It was full of many kinds of flowers and fruits, frequented by many birds, crowded with herds of many animals and visited by siddhas and charanas."

verses.text:
ततः प्रयाते कौन्तेये वनं मानुषवर्जितम् ।
शङ्खानां पटहानां च शब्दः समभवद्दिवि ॥

meaning.en: "When the son of Kunti had gone into the forest empty of men, the sound of conches and drums arose in the sky."

verses.text:
पुष्पवर्षं च सुमहन्निपपात महीतले ।
मेघजालं च विततं छादयामास सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "A great rain of flowers fell on the ground, and a spread of clouds covered everything."

verses.text:
अतीत्य वनदुर्गाणि संनिकर्षे महागिरेः ।
शुशुभे हिमवत्पृष्ठे वसमानोऽर्जुनस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: "Having passed the forest's difficult places, near the great mountain, Arjuna shone as he dwelt on the Himalaya's ridge."

verses.text:
तत्रापश्यद्द्रुमान्फुल्लान्विहगैर्वल्गु नादितान् ।
नदीश्च बहुलावर्ता नीलवैडूर्यसंनिभाः ॥

meaning.en: "There he saw flowering trees sweetly sounding with birds, and rivers with many whirlpools, like blue lapis lazuli."

verses.text:
हंसकारण्डवोद्गीताः सारसाभिरुतास्तथा ।
पुंस्कोकिलरुताश्चैव क्रौञ्चबर्हिणनादिताः ॥

meaning.en: "The rivers rang with swans and karandavas, with cranes' cries, the cries of male cuckoos, and the calls of curlews and peacocks."

verses.text:
मनोहरवनोपेतास्तस्मिन्नतिरथोऽर्जुनः ।
पुण्यशीतामलजलाः पश्यन्प्रीतमनाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: "Seeing these rivers in that lovely forest, with holy, cool and clear waters, the great charioteer Arjuna became glad."

verses.text:
रमणीये वनोद्देशे रममाणोऽर्जुनस्तदा ।
तपस्युग्रे वर्तमान उग्रतेजा महामनाः ॥

meaning.en: "Delighting in that pleasant forest region, Arjuna, of fierce energy and great mind, engaged in fierce austerity."

verses.text:
दर्भचीरं निवस्याथ दण्डाजिनविभूषितः ।
पूर्णे पूर्णे त्रिरात्रे तु मासमेकं फलाशनः ।
द्विगुणेनैव कालेन द्वितीयं मासमत्यगात् ॥

meaning.en: "Wearing a garment of darbha grass and bark and adorned with staff and deerskin, he ate fruit once a month, at the end of each three nights; he passed the second month in double that time."

verses.text:
तृतीयमपि मासं स पक्षेणाहारमाचरन् ।
शीर्णं च पतितं भूमौ पर्णं समुपयुक्तवान् ॥

meaning.en: "In the third month he took food once a fortnight, eating leaves that had withered and fallen to the ground."

verses.text:
चतुर्थे त्वथ संप्राप्ते मासि पूर्णे ततः परम् ।
वायुभक्षो महाबाहुरभवत्पाण्डुनन्दनः ।
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्निरालम्बः पादाङ्गुष्ठाग्रविष्ठितः ॥

meaning.en: "When the fourth month came and was complete, the mighty-armed son of Pandu lived on air alone, arms raised, without support, standing on the tips of his big toes."

verses.text:
सदोपस्पर्शनाच्चास्य बभूवुरमितौजसः ।
विद्युदम्भोरुहनिभा जटास्तस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: "Because he bathed constantly, the matted locks of that great, boundless-energy man became like lightning and lotus color."

verses.text:
ततो महर्षयः सर्वे जग्मुर्देवं पिनाकिनम् ।
शितिकण्ठं महाभागं प्रणिपत्य प्रसाद्य च ।
सर्वे निवेदयामासुः कर्म तत्फल्गुनस्य ह ॥

meaning.en: "Then all the great sages went to the god Pinakin, the blue-throated, the glorious; they bowed and pleased him, and all reported Phalguna's deed."

verses.text:
एष पार्थो महातेजा हिमवत्पृष्ठमाश्रितः ।
उग्रे तपसि दुष्पारे स्थितो धूमाययन्दिशः ॥

meaning.en: "This radiant Partha has taken refuge on the Himalaya's ridge and stands in fierce, hard-to-complete austerity, making the directions smoke."

verses.text:
तस्य देवेश न वयं विद्मः सर्वे चिकीर्षितम् ।
संतापयति नः सर्वानसौ साधु निवार्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Lord of gods, we do not all know what he intends; he is tormenting all of us; please stop him well."

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
शीघ्रं गच्छत संहृष्टा यथागतमतन्द्रिताः ।
अहमस्य विजानामि संकल्पं मनसि स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Go quickly, glad and untiring, as you came. I know the purpose that stays in his mind."

verses.text:
नास्य स्वर्गस्पृहा काचिन्नैश्वर्यस्य न चायुषः ।
यत्त्वस्य काङ्क्षितं सर्वं तत्करिष्येऽहमद्य वै ॥

meaning.en: "He has no desire for heaven, for sovereignty or for long life; whatever he wishes I will do today."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ते श्रुत्व शर्ववचनमृषयः सत्यवादिनः ।
प्रहृष्टमनसो जग्मुर्यथास्वं पुनराश्रमान् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of Sharva, the truthful sages, glad of mind, went back to their own hermitages.
